verdict.rationale: Gitea is a self-hosted Git service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server documented under the Gitea organization at gitea.com/gitea/gitea-mcp, which delivers the core of the story. The evidence is a single probe line with no detail on tools, setup or agent compatibility. Missing for 10: documentation of the exposed tools and operations, setup and authentication instructions for connecting an agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://gitea.com/gitea/gitea-mcp
